# Meritline Tax Services

> Meritline Tax Services is an online U.S. tax compliance service for people outside the United States who own a U.S. LLC. It prepares and files Form 5472 with the pro forma Form 1120 for foreign-owned single-member LLCs, state annual reports and state tax returns, Form 7004 extensions, FBAR (FinCEN Form 114), and catch-up filings with reasonable cause statements for missed years. Clients in any country are served fully online by email and WhatsApp, with a fixed written quote before any work begins.

- Website: https://meritlinetaxservices.com/
- Email: info@meritlinetaxservices.com
- WhatsApp: +44 7520659818
- Hours: Monday to Friday, 7:00 AM to 5:00 PM GMT
- Managing Director: Mmesoma Winner (https://www.linkedin.com/in/mmesoma-winner-516109437/)
- Legal name: Meritline Tax Services LLC, registered in New Mexico, USA (October 20, 2026)
- Address: 1209 Mountain Road Pl NE, Ste R, Albuquerque, NM 87110, USA
- Meritline Tax Services is independent and is not affiliated with the IRS or any government agency. Website content is general information, not tax or legal advice.

## Core guides

- [U.S. LLC Tax Glossary for Foreign Owners](https://meritlinetaxservices.com/blog/us-llc-tax-glossary.html): plain-English definitions of 52 terms, from Form 5472 and disregarded entity to ECI, FBAR, and franchise tax
- [Form 5472 Explained: The Complete Guide for Foreign Owners of U.S. LLCs](https://meritlinetaxservices.com/blog/form-5472-explained.html): who must file, reportable transactions, what each part asks, filing by fax, penalties, common mistakes
- [Form 5472 Example: A Completed Sample](https://meritlinetaxservices.com/blog/form-5472-example-filled-out.html): Form 5472 and the pro forma Form 1120 filled in for a fictional foreign-owned single-member LLC, line by line, with a free PDF
- [Can I File Form 5472 Myself?](https://meritlinetaxservices.com/blog/can-i-file-form-5472-myself.html): honest self-check, DIY steps, common mistakes, and a DIY review option
- [Form 5472 Deadline 2026 and 2027](https://meritlinetaxservices.com/blog/form-5472-deadline-2026-2027.html): the 2026 tax year return is due April 15, 2027, or October 15, 2027 with Form 7004
- [Form 5472 Extension: How to File Form 7004 for a Foreign-Owned LLC](https://meritlinetaxservices.com/blog/form-5472-extension-form-7004.html): foreign-owned LLCs fax Form 7004 to 855-887-7737 or mail it to the dedicated Ogden, Utah address
- [Form 5472 Late Filing Penalty: How Abatement Works](https://meritlinetaxservices.com/blog/form-5472-late-filing-penalty-abatement.html): the $25,000 penalty, reasonable cause, first-time abatement limits, appeals
- [Missed the October 15 Form 5472 Deadline?](https://meritlinetaxservices.com/blog/missed-october-15-form-5472-deadline.html)
- [Form 5472 Tax Year and Due Dates](https://meritlinetaxservices.com/blog/form-5472-tax-year-due-dates.html): calendar year, fiscal year, and the first short year
- [Do U.S. Owners Need Form 5472?](https://meritlinetaxservices.com/blog/form-5472-us-owners-and-corporations.html)
- [Form 1120 vs. Form 1065](https://meritlinetaxservices.com/blog/form-1120-vs-form-1065.html)
- [U.S. Tax Deadlines for 2027](https://meritlinetaxservices.com/blog/us-tax-deadlines-2027.html)
